findings.description: Optional arguments whose type returns a bracketed metavar now receive duplicate brackets in help output.
findings.rationale: For an optional Choice argument, such as click.Argument(['mode'], type=click.Choice(['a', 'b'])), the type returns '[a|b]'. Unconditionally wrapping that value produces '[[a|b]]' in usage output instead of '[a|b]'; the removed already_bracketed guard prevented this.
